AI Explorer

Welcome to the AI Explorer. This view brings together posts that our pipeline flagged as AI-generated and 
lets you investigate patterns across parties, platforms, and message content. Use column filters to slice 
the data, sort on any header to compare like-for-like, and search the post text to surface specific phrases 
or narratives. The goal is to keep exploration fast and visual while preserving an easy path back to the 
original source.


What to look for: the combined 
Tags
 column shows compact topic/theme chips; the 

 column indicates whether an explicit AI disclosure is present. Click a row’s 
Link
 to open the original post for full context on the platform.





Sort & search
Click any column header to sort. Use the search box above the table to find words in the post text (case-insensitive). Combine with filters for focused views.





Filter by Actor
Narrow the list to a party, politician, or actor type. Select “All” to clear the filter and return to the full set.





Filter by Platform
Limit results to Facebook, Instagram, X, or TikTok from the Platform header filter. Use multiple filters together to compare like-for-like content.





Tags (topics + themes)
Posts carry compact chips for annotated topics and themes. If a +N chip appears, hover to see the hidden tags;  chips are designed to stay short so the table remains readable.





AI label indicator

The 

 column marks explicit AI disclosure: 

 labeled (✓), 

 no label (×), 

 unknown (?).






Open the original
Use the Link column to open the post in a new tab on its source platform and verify content in context.
